messages:
Amy (support): FYI we have an enterprise escalation — ACME is seeing ~2x embedding units on the Console vs what their side expects. They provided sample calls and billing spikes. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/acme/embeds-spike.png :grimacing:
Amy (support): Repro steps I used quickly:
```bash
# single request example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"hello world","customer_id":"acme-123"}'
```
Amy (support): On the Dashboard the "Embedding units" chart shows two lines: "vectors" and "tokens" and totalable to 2x the expected. Customer claims they only count vector units.
Mike (metrics): Can you paste the raw events count for a small time window (e.g. 2024-11-01T10:00-10:10 UTC)? Want to see if counts come from duplicated events or mapping mismatch.
Amy (support): Pasted a csv dump to the thread: https://redwood.sheets/acme-dump.csv (contains request_id, event_type, units, vector_dim, tokens, partition)
Olivia (analytics): Quick glance: I see matching request_id repeated across 2 partitions for same logical request in rows 42..48 — looks like replayed/kafka-redelivery scenarios. The metric ETL does a GROUP BY on customer_id + time_bucket but earlier code was summing both tokens and vectors into the same metric name.
Jess (eng): I think the product mapping in the dashboard is wrong — front-end chart expects "embedding_units" where ETL should emit a single canonical unit field. Right now pipeline emits both `vector_count` and `token_count` and the UI stacks them. Suspect cause: a migration we deployed last week that added token-level telemetry for trial models, but didn't update the rollup rule to de-duplicate by `request_id`.
Jess (eng): Repro/local hypothesis:
```sql
-- current faulty rollup
SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts) as bucket, customer_id, sum(vector_count) as vectors, sum(token_count) as tokens
FROM embed_events
WHERE ts between $start and $end
GROUP BY bucket, customer_id;
-- UI then stacks vectors + tokens labeled as "units"
```
Jess (eng): Fix is either emit a single `embedding_units` per request (prefer) or change rollup to coalesce: `sum(greatest(vector_count, token_count))` or `sum( CASE WHEN vector_count>0 THEN vector_count ELSE token_count END )` and dedupe by request_id.
Olivia (analytics): I ran a corrected rollup against the last 24h and the totals align with ACME's internal numbers (diff <1%). I can run a backfill patch to regenerate the 7-day chart.
deploy-bot: Pipeline alert: "kafka-processor-01" backfill job started by */analytics* at 2024-11-02T12:05:13Z (job id fb-20241102-77)
Mike (metrics): Important: before backfill we need to ensure idempotency keys are set: the pipeline dedupe window uses `event_id` but many events only have `request_id`. If we dedupe on request_id we'll collapse legitimate multi-chunk events. Need to ensure we dedupe on `(request_id, chunk_index)` semantics, and then coalesce units per request.
Raj (billing): From billing side I propose: 1) Issue a one-time credit for ACME for the visible overbilling window. 2) Pause invoice generation until backfill completes and we verify corrected numbers. Assigning to Raj to decide credit amount after analytics patch.
Amy (support): ACME customer call scheduled 2024-11-02 15:30 UTC. I'll update them that we're investigating root cause and will run a backfill to fix charts.
Jess (eng): Action items:
- Jess to open PR to emit `embedding_units` (single canonical metric) and add request_id-based coalesce (owner: Jess)
- Olivia to run backfill/recalc for affected windows and produce verification spreadsheet (owner: Olivia)
- Mike to add monitoring alert for rate of repeated request_id across partitions (owner: Mike)
- Raj to draft credit proposal for ACME (owner: Raj)
Amy (support): tagging owners to keep ACME in loop: @Jess, @Olivia, @Mike, @Raj :eyes:
Olivia (analytics): I'll post the verification CSV to the support ticket once backfill completes. ETA ~2h.
Mike (metrics): I'll add a temporary dashboard that shows "raw_event_dupe_ratio" and a threshold alert to avoid silent double-counting in future.
Raj (billing): I'll hold on credits until Olivia confirms backfilled totals. If diff >5% we'll auto-approve a 100% credit for the delta.
Amy (support): Thanks team. I'll update the customer after backfill. :thumbsup:
Jess (eng): FYI I found the exact bad deploy: commit b4f3c2e added token telemetry but missed ETL mapping. I'll open a hotfix PR to revert the mapping change and add tests.
deploy-bot: Hotfix PR created: https://git.redwood/pulls/982 - merging will trigger a small replay job.
Olivia (analytics): Backfill finished. Verified numbers match ACME internal logs. Posting results: https://redwood.sheets/acme-verify-20241102.csv
Amy (support): Closing loop with ACME now. Will log the incident in postmortems if billing impact >$X.
Raj (billing): Credit approved (pending verification sheet).
Amy (support): Thread summary for postmortem: UI stacked separate unit fields, ETL emitted both token_count & vector_count, missing per-request coalesce + dedupe allowed double-count during kafka replays. Fixes: emit canonical `embedding_units`, add dedupe on request_id, add dupe-ratio alert, run backfill.
